SELECT 
    c.segment,
    COUNT(s.sale_id) as total_sales,
    SUM(s.amount) as total_revenue
FROM (
    SELECT sale_id, cust_id, amount
    FROM sales
    WHERE sale_time_str >= '2026-04-01 08:00:00' AND sale_time_str < '2026-04-02 08:00:00'
) s
JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
GROUP BY c.segment
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

WITH filtered_sales AS (
  SELECT sale_id, cust_id, amount
  FROM sales
  WHERE sale_time_str >= '2026-04-01 08:00:00'
),
joined_result AS (
  SELECT c.segment, COUNT(fs.sale_id) as total_sales, SUM(fs.amount) as total_revenue
  FROM filtered_sales fs
  JOIN customers c ON fs.cust_id = c.cust_id
  GROUP BY c.segment
)
SELECT segment, total_sales, total_revenue
FROM joined_result
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT s.sale_id, c.segment, s.amount * m.trend_index as adjusted_revenue
FROM sales s
JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
JOIN market_trends m ON c.segment = m.segment
WHERE s.sale_time_str >= '2026-04-01 10:00:00'
  AND m.trend_index > 0.5
ORDER BY adjusted_revenue DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT 
    s.sale_id,
    c.segment,
    s.amount * m.trend_index as adjusted_revenue
FROM (
    SELECT 
        sale_id,
        cust_id,
        amount,
        sale_time_str
    FROM sales
    WHERE sale_time_str > '2026-04-01 10:00:00'
) s
JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        segment,
        trend_index
    FROM market_trends
    WHERE trend_index > 0.5
) m ON c.segment = m.segment
ORDER BY s.amount * m.trend_index DESC
LIMIT 100;
